message: ――A few days have passed since the semifinals
Today is finally the day, and the finals are taking place.

name: Momiji
message: 「Yawn~n, I'm sleepy~……」

name: Iori
message: 「Did you get enough sleep last night？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that part's fine」

name: Iori
message: 「What about Setsugekka. Did you sleep well」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of cour~se！ Slept like a log, pooped like a champ, condition is toootal perfection！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't say things like pooping like a champ as a girl」
There was still plenty of time until the match, but playing it safe, I left the dorm early with the two of them.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Now that I think about it, Momimomi falls asleep super fast, doesn't she. Even if I pinch your cheek, you don't wake up」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that right」

name: Momiji
message: 「When we had that sleepover before, I wondered why my cheek felt weirdly off—it was your fault?!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's fine, I gave you a kiss to make up for pinching it！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Whoa~, what a nightmare……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hold on, hold on, that's not the part where you make a disgusted face, right！？ Isn't that where your face turns all rosy and flustered！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sorry, I'm not into that kind of thing」
Showing our passes, we go through the entrance for staff and participants, entering the venue a step ahead of the crowd.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Phew, now there's no need to worry about being late~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Listen, being late to the Martial Festival finals would be completely unheard of, you know」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Momimomi looks like she'd oversleep, though」

name: Momiji
message: 「Like I would」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aha~n, it's only because I wake you up that you manage not to oversleep~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Your perception is way off there」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I took away Setsugekka's role of waking me up, I'd feel bad for you, so I reluctantly let you wake me」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, keep serving me diligently from here on out, won't you~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Who the hell do you think you are, hey」

name: Iori
message: 「Right then, we still have some time, but what should we do？」
It felt a bit too early to change into my Spirit-Type Armament now, anyway.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, that’s right. Why don’t we head over to the spectator seats？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, let’s go check it out.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, the guests are already coming in.」

name: Momiji
message: 「There’s still plenty of time until the matches, isn't there?」
General admission had already begun at the venue. Spectators were pouring in one after another.

name: Iori
message: 「The finals are particularly popular. The unreserved seats are a free-for-all, and I hear there are even standing-room-only crowds.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Unreserved seats, huh... I only have memories of being pestered by some weird old guy when I was a kid.」

name: Iori
message: 「Were you okay？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, I was already learning Mishima-ryuu Martial Arts back then. I took him down with one strike to the crotch.」

name: Momiji
message: 「How barbaric...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Have you never been pestered, Momimomi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, I was always in the invited seating area, so.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Pah！ This is why ladies of the Suzakuin family are the worst！ Must be nice to be so privileged, huh！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei, I’m being pestered by a weird old guy, please help me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Who are you calling an old guy!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka, don't make such a scene in public. You’re a celebrity now, you know.」
The general spectators began to stir as they recognized Setsugekka and Momiji.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「O-oh, ohhh... I’m the center of attention！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, let’s move, shall we?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, good idea.」
We arrived at the top floor, which overlooked the arena.
Inside the venue, the first round and semi-final matches of the Martial Festival were being broadcast via live viewing.
The excitement of the cheering crowd reached us.

name: Iori
message: 「...I’m a lucky man.」

name: Iori
message: 「So many people have gone out of their way to come here just to see the matches of the two people standing here.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m truly proud to have been involved with both of you.」
Being able to share their grand moment with everyone here. That was what made me happier than anything else.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, and Momiji.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, what is it？」
The two of them turned around and faced me.
The final match—whether we cry or laugh, this is it.
No matter who wins or who loses. I want them to have a match with no regrets.
I started to say that... but suddenly stopped myself.
—There was no pretense in the way Setsugekka smiled so brightly.
—Momiji already had the face of a swordswoman.
There was nothing left that I needed to say to them.

name: Iori
message: 「...I’ll be watching over both of you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah.」
And once the match is over, safely...
I want them to come back to me.
